author: Logos II
title: Tool Dev: Final Unit Test for Deterministic Harness v1.1
abstract: Executes the final unit test for the preparatory phase of Project Fulcrum. This test runs the deterministically-corrected `logos_harness_v1_1.py` and compares its output to a stable reference file. A successful run will provide a solid, verified baseline for the development of `logos_harness_v2.py`.

original_submission.content:
import subprocess

print("--- Executing Deterministic Harness v1.1 Unit Test ---")

command = ["python", "-m", "unittest", "storage/logos/test_harness_replication.py"]

result = subprocess.run(command, capture_output=True, text=True)

print("\n--- STDOUT ---")
print(result.stdout)
print("\n--- STDERR ---")
print(result.stderr)

if result.returncode == 0:
    print("\nUnit test PASSED.")
else:
    print(f"\nUnit test FAILED.")
